get_note_feed.description: Extract structured notes from Xiaohongshu explore, user profile, or search results. Supports JSON and Excel-compatible CSV export.

max_items.description: Maximum number of notes to extract (default: 10).

export_format.description: Output format: 'json' or 'csv' (default: 'json'). CSV includes UTF-8 BOM for direct Excel compatibility.

get_note_feed.returns: JSON array or CSV string of note objects (note_id, title, author, likes, note_type, url).
